title: A Validated Volatility-Volume-Gap Classifier for Regime Identification in MNQ Intraday Data
abstract: arXiv:2605.11423v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper builds and tests a day-classification system for MNQ (Micro E-Mini Nasdaq 100) futures based on three simultaneously elevated pre-market conditions: absolute overnight gap, absolute first-30-minute return, and first-bar volume relative to a 20-day rolling baseline. The Volatility-Volume-Gap (VVG) classifier is evaluated on 947 trading days of five-minute data from 2021-2025, with all thresholds computed on an expanding window to prevent lookahead bias. The classifier activates on roughly 4.4% of sessions (40 days).   Those days exhibit measurably distinct behavior: 77.6% reverse from their intraday peak before the close, mean peak-to-close giveback of 11.73 points, and a 25.6 basis point next-day return spread versus non-classifier days. translated_title: 用于MNQ日内数据市场状态识别的经过验证的波动率-成交量-跳空分类器
translated_abstract: 本文构建并测试了一个针对MNQ（微型E-迷你纳斯达克100）期货的日分类系统，该系统基于三种同时处于高位的盘前条件：绝对隔夜跳空、绝对前30分钟收益率，以及相对于20日滚动基准的首根K线成交量。该波动率-成交量-跳空分类器在2021至2025年共947个交易日的五分钟数据上进行了评估，所有阈值均采用扩展窗口计算以防止前视偏差。该分类器在约4.4%的交易时段（40天）被激活。这些交易日表现出可测量的独特行为：77.6%的交易日在收盘前从日内高点回落，平均高点到收盘的回吐幅度为11.73点，且相对于非分类器交易日存在25.6个基点的次日收益率差异。逐年分析揭示了显著的路径异质性——2024年分类器日的平均收盘为+40.74点，而2025年则暴跌至-42.48点——这是任何方向性……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出并验证了一个基于隔夜跳空、前30分钟收益率和首根K线成交量三项盘前条件的VVG分类器，能够识别出仅占4.4%但在日内反转行为和次日收益上显著异于常态的MNQ期货交易时段。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces and validates a Volatility-Volume-Gap (VVG) classifier based on three pre-market conditions that identifies a distinct subset (~4.4%) of MNQ futures sessions exhibiting measurably different intraday reversal behavior and next-day returns.
